statement.text:
In this problem, all 3-manifolds are orientable, while all flows are considered up to orbit equivalence and are assumed to be transitive.

(a) Are there only finitely many Anosov flows on a given closed 3-manifold?

(b) Are there only finitely many pseudo-Anosov flows on a given closed 3-manifold?

(c) Are there only finitely many quasigeodesic pseudo-Anosov flows on a given closed 3-manifold?

(d) Are there only finitely many pseudo-Anosov flows without perfect fits on a given closed 3-manifold?

(e) Are there only finitely many veering triangulations on a given finite volume cusped hyperbolic 3-manifold?
